$note: Delivery model story of the Ludwigsburg school: a public client weighing trade lots against a general contractor and a two-stage partnering form. plant_item names the register item the city supplies itself (PL-002, Mensa kitchen). All names invented.

design_bid_build_split.en: Trade lots score highest: the city keeps control of the design, awards by VOB/A in lots that suit local firms, and the Gemeinderat approves each award against the Land funding rules. The price risk and the interfaces between lots stay with the city and are covered in the risk register.
design_bid_build_split.de: Die Fachlosvergabe liegt vorn: Die Stadt behält die Hoheit über die Planung, vergibt nach VOB/A in mittelstandsgerechten Losen, und der Gemeinderat entscheidet jede Vergabe nach den Fördervorgaben des Landes.

rationales.design_bid_build_single: The general contractor option scores highest: one point of responsibility and a fixed price at award, at the cost of larger lots that are harder for local firms and a longer standstill-bound award. The Gemeinderat decides one award instead of several.
rationales.partnering_two_stage: Two-stage partnering scores highest: the contractor joins during design and the summer-holiday window is planned together, but the Land funding rules and the VOB/A award need a documented price basis before the second stage.

owner_capability.funding_source: Municipal budget with Land school construction funding

ground_rationale: Shared on a Baugrund baseline report: the city carries ground worse than the baseline, and the extra cost is reported to the Regierungspraesidium as eligible only up to the approved budget.

ofi_first.description: Mensa production kitchen equipment from the city's framework agreement, installed by the kitchen trade lot

ofi_second.description: Classroom furniture from the Schulamt framework agreement, installed by the school caretakers
